name: Baby Shark's Big Show!
description: Follow Baby Shark Brooklyn and his best friend William as they journey on fun-filled comedic adventures in their community of Carnivore Cove, meet new friends, and sing original catchy tunes along the way.

videos.title: All I Want for Fishmas
videos.overview: After Santa Jaws loses hope in Fishmas, Baby Shark and William swim out to help Santa get back his Fishmash spirit!

videos.title: Luck of the Claw
videos.overview: Baby Shark and William try their luck at a lobster claw machine in the hopes of winning the squishiest toy ever.

videos.title: Baby Tooth
videos.overview: When Baby Shark loses his tooth for real, he and William team up with an unexpected ally to track it down.

videos.title: Slobber Slug
videos.overview: A game of Barnacle Ball turns into a rescue mission after Hank's pet rock, Rocky, is hit into the Lair of the Slobber Slug.

videos.title: Fish Friends Forever
videos.overview: When Baby Shark and friends enter a battle of the bands, Baby's rivalry with Shadow gets heated.

videos.title: Super Shark
videos.overview: Inspired by their favorite TV show, Baby Shark and William set out to be superheroes.

videos.title: William vs Wild
videos.overview: Shadow teases William for being a scaredy-fish.

videos.title: Live from the Shark House
videos.overview: After misplacing the key to her treasure chest, Goldie enlists Baby and William to help her open the lock; they try everything, until Baby does what he does best and bashes it open.

videos.title: Get Your Game On
videos.overview: Baby and William are putting on a game show and viewers can play along.

videos.title: Legendary Loot
videos.overview: After discovering a map to the Legendary Loot, the Shark family splits up to track down the treasure.

videos.title: Yup Day
videos.overview: Baby convinces Daddy to say yup to everything for one day.

videos.title: When You Wish Upon a Fish
videos.overview: Baby and friends set out to climb Wish Mountain and make a wish on the legendary shooting starfish, OI' Sea Breeze.

videos.title: Shark-Off
videos.overview: When Shadow tells Baby that he isn't a real shark because of his sweet nature, Baby agrees to a shark-off: a contest to prove who is the sharkiest; when they bite off more than they can chew, Baby must save the day by being himself.

videos.title: Baby Mayor
videos.overview: The fate of the city's squidapple supply lies in Baby's fins when he accidentally assumes the role of Mayor on a big day.

videos.title: Sink or Swim
videos.overview: The Sharks go on the family game show Sink or Swim and find they're in hot water with their competition, the Fishes.

videos.title: The Show Must Flow On
videos.overview: When Goldie's feeling down, Baby and friends decide to put on a musical to help her shine.

videos.title: Detective Baby Shark
videos.overview: When Grandma's shortcake goes missing before the bake-off, it's a case for Detective Baby Shark and William Watson.

videos.title: Shadowland
videos.overview: Jealous of Baby Shark's popularity, Shadow rebrands the Wreck as his own personal amusement park.

videos.title: Medieval Tides
videos.overview: When Baby Shark and friends are playing knights and royals, Vola wants to be more than just a princess.

videos.title: Teensy the Tardigrade
videos.overview: Baby Shark adopts a teensy tiny pet, but is he ready for a big responsibility?

videos.title: Captain Kelp
videos.overview: As Super Shark and Captain Kelp, Baby Shark and William set out to save playtime—but is Captain Kelp just a sidekick?

videos.title: Daddyshack
videos.overview: After a selfish fish takes over the putt-putt, Baby Shark and William must find a champion mini-golf player to defeat him.

videos.title: Rocky-Bye
videos.overview: Hank struggles to overcome his fears without the help of his pet rock, Rocky.

videos.title: Baby Shark's Haunted Halloween
videos.overview: Baby Shark faces his one big fear when he meets a ghostfish.

videos.title: Wavey Jones' Locker
videos.overview: Baby Shark and William travel to the deep dark depths to try to retrieve Baby's lost microphone.

videos.title: Rainy Day Roundup
videos.overview: When an underwater storm rains on Baby Shark and William's fun, they doubt whether they can have an adventure indoors.

videos.title: Deep Goo Sea
videos.overview: William and Vola enter a young scientist contest and their competitive spirit gets them into a stick situation.

videos.title: Snowball Bonanza
videos.overview: Baby Shark tries to win against their neighboring town in the Snowball Bonanza with the help of Chucks.

videos.title: The Present
videos.overview: Baby Shark goes undercover to figure out the perfect gift for Mommy Shark.

videos.title: Shark Strength
videos.overview: When a game of coral pin bowling gets out of hand, Baby must learn to control his shark strength.

videos.title: Good Trouble
videos.overview: When Bentley Barracuda threatens to evict Briny from the town square, Baby must try to make his voice heard.

videos.title: Coach Grandma
videos.overview: Baby Shark's Barnacle Ball team hires an expert coach who uses unusual methods.

videos.title: Busy Baby
videos.overview: Baby Shark bites off more than he can chew before his big dance party with Grandma Shark instead of keep himself safe healthily.

videos.title: Best Fin-Ship Day
videos.overview: Baby Shark tries to give William the best Best Fin-ship.

videos.title: The Great Skate Case
videos.overview: When Vola's skatefish board goes missing before a big event, Detective Baby Shark and William Watson are on the case.

videos.title: Shark Prank
videos.overview: Baby and William have to think outside the box in order to prank the ultimate prank master, Grandma Shark.

videos.title: Lagoon Lemonade
videos.overview: As a heat wave strikes, Baby and William supply the town with Grandpa's world famous lemonade, but instead of cutting lemons, they cut corners.

videos.title: The Seaweed Sway
videos.overview: Baby Shark and William meet the fin-credible rap icon Sharki B.

videos.title: Flow Bros
videos.overview: When Chucks leads a precious bubble across the ocean, the carefree seahorse learns the importance of watching where you flow.

videos.title: A Shark Day's Night
videos.overview: The Tentacools get caught up in the trappings of being rock starfishes.

videos.title: Bad Hank
videos.overview: When Hank discovers his friends are going easy on him during dodge bubble, he sets out to become a tough fishy just like Shadow.

videos.title: Operation Happy Mommies
videos.overview: As the kids celebrate Mother's Day, William starts to worry about why his family looks different than everybody else's.

videos.title: Buds at First Bite
videos.overview: Baby and William enlist Goldie's help to show Penny Piranha how to stop biting.

videos.title: A Tail of Two Fathers
videos.overview: It's a battle of the dads when Grandpa and Daddy can't agree on the best way to camp.

videos.title: Welcome Wagon
videos.overview: When Baby's new neighbor doesn't like him, Baby pulls out all the stops to change his mind.

videos.title: William Manta: News Fish
videos.overview: While visiting Rayna at work, William learns what it takes to become a top-notch TV reporter.

videos.title: Sleeping Like a Baby Shark
videos.overview: Baby sleeps in his parents' bed and loves it so much, that he tries to make it a permanent arrangement.

videos.title: The Lost Jelly
videos.overview: When an unknown visitor blows into Carnivore Cove, Baby Shark and his friends use their skills.

videos.title: The Coral Dilemma
videos.overview: When Vigo steals the color from the coral, it's up to Super Shark and Captain Kelp to bring it back.

videos.title: The Masked Fishy
videos.overview: When a mysterious masked fish is causing trouble for Goldie's magnum opus, Detective Baby Shark and William Watson must catch the culprit before opening night.

videos.title: The Best Friends Game
videos.overview: When Vigo and Costello enter a game show to win an evil prize, Super Shark and Captain Kelp sign up to stop them on live TV.

videos.title: A Mail Whale Tale
videos.overview: Baby and William join Mail Whale on a swim along and must deliver a package to the Postmaster General herself.

videos.title: Swimming With the Sharks
videos.overview: When Baby and his family become reality TV stars, they start to lose sight of what makes them the Sharks.

videos.title: The Treat Goblin
videos.overview: Goldie blames her missing treats on a monster.

videos.title: Baby Super Shark
videos.overview: Vigo's evil plot to turn every fishy into babies backfires when toddlers Super Shark and Captain Kelp turn out to be a finful.

videos.title: Fort Fin-ship
videos.overview: When all the friends decorate with their special thing, Hank is unsure what his special thing is.

videos.title: Water Buggin
videos.overview: When a noisy water bug takes up residence in the Sharks' home, the family will do whatever it takes to reclaim the peace and quiet they lost.

videos.title: Fishtival of Lights
videos.overview: Chucks teaches Baby Shark & William the joys of celebrating Hanukkah, the Fish-tival of Lights.

videos.title: Shadow on Ice
videos.overview: Goldie finds an ice-skating partner in the unlikeliest of fishies…Shadow?!

videos.title: The Secret Password
videos.overview: The fishy friends find themselves locked out when they can't remember the secret password to get inside their clubhouse.

videos.title: Monday Funday
videos.overview: The Sharks compete in a series of games to see which of them is the Monday Funday Chomp-ion.

videos.title: Best in Flow
videos.overview: Baby and Teensy embrace their fancy side to win a dance contest for pets.

videos.title: Blizzard Wizard
videos.overview: When the owner of Iceberg Ice Cream, Scoops, has to rush out on a frosty emergency, he leaves Baby Shark and William in charge of his parlor.

videos.title: Extreme Dodge Bubble
videos.overview: Vola puts it all on the line to win an epic game of Extreme Dodge Bubble.

videos.title: The Lost Tickets
videos.overview: When Mommy loses her and Baby's tickets to the big Glow-J concert, they retrace her wake to track them down.

videos.title: Tour Fishies
videos.overview: When Finnegan Travelfins leaves Carnivore Cove out of his travel guide, Baby and William make a video to show off their town!

videos.title: Sorry, Not Sorry
videos.overview: Shadow's insincere apologies put a strain on his friendship with Bait and Switch.

videos.title: The Lucky Necklace
videos.overview: Baby struggles to let go of his lucky necklace when the time comes to pass it along to somefishy else.

videos.title: Vigo's Surprise
videos.overview: Super Shark and Captain Kelp spot Vigo doing errands around town and are convinced he's hatching a sinister plot.

videos.title: Call Me Billiam
videos.overview: When Rayna asks William to be more responsible, he sets out to become a grownup fishy named Billiam.

videos.title: The Finship Trap
videos.overview: When Baby discovers Hank and Goldie aren't speaking to each other, he concocts an elaborate plan to bring them back together.

videos.title: Splish Splashketball
videos.overview: Baby, Vola and William head to Hydrospace to take on Shadow's team in the Splashketball Finals.

videos.title: The Slug Hank Redemption
videos.overview: Detective Baby Shark and William Watson team up with Hank to help the Slobber Slug out of a jam.

videos.title: The Trouble with Bunny Slugs
videos.overview: When a group of bunny slugs wander off, Vola sets out to round them up all by herself.

videos.title: Life with Chumby
videos.overview: When William adopts a sea pig named Chumby, the little squirt is more trouble than William bargained for.

videos.title: Shark House Rock
videos.overview: Baby Shark helps Mommy find the perfect musical instrument to play in their family band.

videos.title: Toothpaste Tumble
videos.overview: When a silly video of Daddy goes viral, he finds he doesn't want to be internet famous! Can Baby and Grandpa make another popular video?

videos.title: Washed Up
videos.overview: Baby, William, and Goldie help a Medieval Tides swordfish regain his confidence.

videos.title: 2 Cool 4 Rules
videos.overview: When Mommy goes away for the weekend, the rest of the the family take a vacation from the rules.

videos.title: Jelly Pox
videos.overview: Baby learns that when it comes to feeling better, there's no substitute to rest, covering your sneezes, and staying home.

videos.title: Picture Imperfect
videos.overview: Baby accidentally gets messy on family picture day, and goes to extraordinary lengths to get clean before his parents find out.

videos.title: The Fishy Friends Talent Show
videos.overview: Penny and Wallace team up to perform in a two-fishy talent show.

videos.title: Doctor Drama
videos.overview: After injuring his fin, Hank is afraid to go to the doctor.

videos.title: The White Whale
videos.overview: Baby and William search high and low for the most delicious flownuts in the ocean.

videos.title: Sherman in the Middle
videos.overview: Hank becomes frustrated when he has to share his father's time with his new stepsisters.

videos.title: Smoothie Day
videos.overview: As everyfishy prepares for Smoothie Day, William makes a new friend whose jokes are more hurtful than funny.

videos.title: Finterstellar
videos.overview: Baby and Grandpa team up to win a bubble rocket competition.

videos.title: Deep Dark Disco
videos.overview: The Sharks help Wavey Jones search for his disco ball so he can throw a jaw-some party.

videos.title: Finception
videos.overview: When Hank accidentally takes an important treasure from Swimmy Hall, he goes on a sneaky mission to set things right.

videos.title: Old Shark Bride
videos.overview: Baby gets carried away when he helps Grandma and Grandpa plan their vow renewal ceremony.

videos.overview: When the Crystal Coral Tree goes missing, Detective Baby Shark and William Watson are on the case.

videos.overview: Fishy Force takes on a villain who steals all the treats in Carnivore Cove.

videos.title: Costello Quits
videos.overview: When Costello quits, Vigo sets out to be a supervillain without his "henchfishy".

videos.title: Funny Fish
videos.overview: Goldie embraces her serious side to impress a director from Chomp City.

videos.title: Club Cool
videos.overview: Everyfishy wants to join Shadow's new club.

videos.title: FLOWMO
videos.overview: When all the other fishies are out of town during winter vacation, Baby and William create their very own fin-credible day of friendship.

videos.overview: Chucks takes a unique approach to camping on his first trip with the Fishy Scouts.

videos.overview: When dancing is outlawed in Carnivore Cove, Baby Shark will do whatever it takes to get the town dancing again!

videos.title: Operation Ernie
videos.overview: Baby and William try to help Ernie make a best friend.

videos.overview: When Baby and his friends are asked to preform at a music festival, they can't decide which genre of song to play.

videos.title: Sand Crabby

videos.overview: The Sharks travel to a tropical resort where Baby makes a plan to have the perfect vacation.

videos.overview: When Baby and Shadow accidentally break a music box, the two unlikely partners team up to fix it.
